author: Gmelin, 1789
habitat: 저지대 습지 주변, 툰드라, 아고산대 관목림, 물가
summary: 저지대 습지 주변에서 툰드라, 아고산대 관목림까지 여러 곳에 사는 도요새이다. 물가에서 곤충, 연체동물, 십각류 등을 잡아먹는다. 물가 근처의 얕게 파인 곳에 둥지를 짓고 알 4개를 낳는다. 캐나다, 남아메리카 남부, 알래스카에 분포한다.

points.en: bill about 1.5 times as long as the head

young: 어린새는 윗면이 어른 겨울깃보다 짙은 흑갈색이고 깃 가장자리에 연한 황갈색·흰색 점무늬가 있으며, 목과 가슴에 갈색 세로줄이 더 굵고 촘촘하다.

similar.how: 크기와 생김새가 청다리도요와 비슷하지만 다리가 선명한 노란색이다.

art.subject: Greater Yellowlegs (Tringa melanoleuca), adult in breeding plumage, as seen in spring: head and neck heavily streaked black on white; back and wing coverts dark grey-brown, spangled with black centres and neat white spots and notches; breast and flanks boldly marked with black spots and chevron bars; belly white. Square white rump; white tail finely barred grey. Long blackish bill; dark eye; long bright yellow legs.
art.pose: wading at the water's edge, picking insects from the surface
art.scene: Korean lowland wetland edge with shallow pools and fresh green sedges in May; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding, side view standing: long, slightly upturned blackish bill about 1.5 times the head length, black-spangled grey-brown back, black-barred breast and flanks, white belly, long bright yellow legs
adult, head detail: bill about 1.5 times the head length, stout at the base and slightly upturned, head and neck finely streaked black
art.build: Tall, slender wader about the size of a Common Greenshank, with a long neck and small head. Bill about one and a half times the head length, rather stout at the base, straight or very slightly upturned. Legs very long, bright yellow to orange-yellow, with much bare tibia showing. At rest the wingtips reach about the tail tip. In flight a plain dark upperwing without a wing bar, a square white rump patch that does not extend up the back, and the feet projecting beyond the tail.
avoid: Do not paint grey-green legs or a white wedge running up the back; those mark the Common Greenshank (Tringa nebularia).
Do not make the bill short and fine, only about head length; that is the Lesser Yellowlegs (Tringa flavipes).
Do not curve the bill downwards.
Do not add a white wing bar.
